name: Tabs: blue professional
description: Title and lede, then a tinted frame holding a few tabs, each with its own panel (a list, a table or a paragraph); tabs switch on click during playback and only the first shows when static. Three separate slides would lose the contrast of switching within one frame.

kicker.hint: chapter label top left, e.g. "01 — Why"; numbered automatically by the scaffold when the slides in the story carry a chapter, otherwise left empty

meta.hint: rounded tag top right: audience, phase or occasion, up to 10 characters, filled automatically from the first clause of occasion; leave empty when not needed

title.hint: the slide's claim in one sentence, up to 2 lines and 26 characters; *keyword* marks an emphasis (blue)

subtitle.hint: a one-line lede, up to 50 characters

panels.hint: 2 to 5 tabs, tab labels up to 6 characters; each panel holds 3 to 5 items or a small table; the first panel is what static output and QA see

title.value: Three audiences, each on their own tab

subtitle.value: Managers see metrics, engineers the backlog, support the reporting flow; the data is the same.

items: Click a metric for its trend
Each item has an owner and a stop-loss point

rows: Send the link to the report form
Check the status page before replying

caption.value: Click a tab to switch during playback; static mode shows only the first panel.
